newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks bounce back, end higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks bounce back, end higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rebounded to end up on Tuesday as select buying in blue chips countered early selling by speculators on new accounts day, dealers said.
"The index rebounded as select blue chips rose on new accounts day buying that offset early selling pressure," one dealer said. "But overall sentiment is weak as major players are on the sidelines."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 6.71 points, or 0.45 percent, to end at 1,486.21. Losers led gainers 173 to 74. Engro Chemicals rose 6.0 rupees to 145. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
